'''Hervey''' and '''Lagatha''' are NPC Royan's found inside the [[Everfrost Cavern]] at 06:00-21:59.

Appears after {{Quest|The Star That Voyages Far}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Hervey:''' Found any new Royan runes around here?

:'''Lagatha:''' Not yet… but since a Void Storm passed through this area, we should come across some sooner or later.

:'''Lagatha:''' Once we're done here, let's first head back to Bjartr Woods.

:'''Hervey:''' Should we send the recorded patterns to the Solisylum?

:'''Lagatha:''' Yes. The Shaper will want to see them.

:'''Lagatha:''' Wherever Void Storms pass, Royan runes are left behind. In a way, they bring both the unknown and blessings with them. This place is no exception.

:'''Hervey:''' If only there were more runes we could actually interpret...

:'''Lagatha:''' Time will reveal the answers, Hervey. Besides, we do have a genius when it comes to rune deciphering.

:'''Hervey:''' Oh, you mean Sigrika?

:'''Lagatha:''' Exactly. She'll be thrilled to see new runes. Let's call it a little gift for her.

:'''Hervey:''' Hehe, Sigrika's always up late studying runes. You can see the passion written all over her face.

:'''Lagatha:''' If only my son were that brilliant! Ha… these days he just keeps talking about taking a ship and seeing the world.
{{Dialogue End}}
